note: Cities are created implicitly by adding a restaurant -- there is no per-city setup. This file only holds optional extras: a display name, a timezone, and any local list sources worth harvesting.

cities.seed_note: Seeded from the 15 restaurants in the inaugural MICHELIN Guide American South (ceremony 2025-11-03) as a way to bound a starting list, then opened up. The award was the bootstrap, not the membership rule.
